7.7K views · 534 reactions | THE URANIUM THAT LIT FRANCE — WHILE NIGER STAYED IN THE DARK

For decades, uranium from Niger helped power France.

According to Oxfam, one in three light bulbs in France was once powered by Nigerien uranium. Yet approximately 90% of Nigeriens lacked electricity.

Africa has supplied the resources that fuel other people's prosperity for far too long. The question is no longer simply what lies beneath our soil. It is who benefits from it.

Africa must not simply supply the world. Africa must benefit, too.
